gen-fs-expose-rubik: Expose packs its letters tight, with caps and lowercase nearly the same height and hardly a pause between them. Rubik, a plain sans with soft, open rounds and big lowercase, gives that compressed rhythm somewhere gentle to land.
gen-fs-familjen-grotesk-fs-karma: Contemporary and unfussy, Familjen Grotesk lets white space leak into its big round bowls. Karma, a serif with terminals that stop well short of the stem, adds a trustworthy, gently modulated voice that never snags the eye.
gen-fs-gambarino-archivo: Gambarino's heavy, ink-flooded stems taper into hairline joins where the curves meet them. And Archivo, a sans-serif with a tall lowercase, opens its curves outward and keeps things approachable beneath that drama.
gen-fs-gambarino-cabin: Cabin reads warm and open, its letterforms like bent tubing with a constant stroke from top to baseline. Then Gambarino steps in with heavy stems and hairlines that nearly vanish in dim light, so the two make a sharp, dramatic pairing.
gen-fs-gambarino-dm-sans: DM Sans reads friendly and approachable, a sans-serif whose wide-set terminals on the s keep each word easy on the eye. Gambarino's pale hairline threads between black stems supply the drama above it.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-chillax: Gambarino hits hard, with stark gaps between stem and hairline. Chillax, a plain sans with no stroke contrast and loose, pen-lifted curves, carries a longer passage in a casual, relaxed, spaghetti-like line.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-roundo: Dramatic and authoritative, Gambarino swells its curves before tapering them into wire-thin ends. Roundo, a plain sans whose horizontals are no thinner than its verticals, keeps a long passage neutral, geometric and unclogged in every small counter.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-spline-sans: Authoritative and a bit theatrical, Gambarino sets hair-thin crossbars against bold stems. Spline Sans, a plain sans with identical vertical and horizontal weight and wide gaps at its curve ends, steadies the page with a contemporary, approachable tone.
gen-fs-gambarino-gf-lexend-peta: Gambarino's bold stems and hairline strokes give it a drama you notice at once. And Lexend Peta, a plain sans drawn like a technical pen with a big x-height, answers that with unthinned curves.
gen-fs-gambarino-montserrat: Gambarino has round letters with fat sides and hairline tops, moderate in lowercase height. And Montserrat, a sans with a high lowercase, glides along like marker-drawn wire, so the two feel like velvet against a smooth wire.
